evals.prompt: Make an implementation plan and task breakdown from output/prd/PRD_auth.md
evals.expected_output: output/tasks/PLAN_<feature>.md contains a requirements summary, impact analysis, a task breakdown with parallelization, a dependency graph, test strategy, doc update plan, and risks, and the tasks are appended to the feature list in PROGRESS.md. Source is not modified.
assertions: A file starting with PLAN_ is created under output/tasks/
Tasks are classified as parallel or sequential with dependencies shown
Unit and E2E test strategies are present
Tasks are added to the feature list in output/tasks/PROGRESS.md with passes=❌
No files under src/ are modified

evals.prompt: skip the plan, just go ahead and implement it
evals.expected_output: As a planning skill it does not start implementing; it outputs the plan, waits for human approval, and says implementation happens afterwards with /implementing-features.
assertions: No source or test files are modified
It says it waits for design approval
